proposed_execution_tasks.title: Lock the deployable service baseline and single-VM topology
proposed_execution_tasks.summary_zh: 鎖定 service、compose、cloud 路徑共用的 baseline：ports、env names、volume mounts、health surfaces、profile 邊界與 owner split。
acceptance: single-VM and future cloud deployment use one explicit port/env/volume contract
runtime-control, governance, evidence, BFF, and delivery-platform boundaries are documented without overlap

proposed_execution_tasks.summary_zh: 把 registry 的 artifact_state 與 deployment_stage 分離語義落成真實 API、schema、storage 與 smoke test，不再只停在 contract。
acceptance: registry service surfaces expose artifact state separately from deployment stage

proposed_execution_tasks.summary_zh: 把 ApprovalDecision canonical contract 落成可部署 governance API、write owner matrix、audit log 與 approval lookup/read path。

acceptance: deployment writes and event publication use an explicit transactional outbox path
